landing.hero.sub: One-to-one Tahfeez & Tajweed with certified Qurraa. Personalised tracks, ijazah pathways, and a teacher who knows your name.
landing.why.title: A path of memorisation, walked with care.
landing.why.sub: We pair you with a teacher, build a plan around your life, and stay until you reach the last page.
landing.why.item0.d: Teachers hold ijazah in Hafs & Warsh, with sanad to the Prophet ﷺ. Every teacher is verified.
landing.why.item1.d: Never a group, never a recording. Live face-to-face with the same teacher every session.
landing.why.item2.d: Memorisation, review, and tajweed timed to your life — students, professionals, parents, retirees.
landing.why.item3.d: New pages, old pages, and a structured review cycle so what you memorise actually stays.
landing.why.item4.d: Pronunciation corrected gently in every session. Makharij and sifaat taught by recitation.
landing.why.item5.d: Complete the Qur'an and walk the chain — full sanad ijazah granted, in shaa Allah.
landing.how.title: Four steps. One Qur'an. A lifetime.
landing.how.sub: From your first message to your first juz, the path is simple.
landing.how.step0.d: A short conversation — your level, goals, and hours. Tahfeez, tajweed, or Arabic — we listen first.
landing.how.step1.d: We hand-pick a teacher matched to your level, gender preference, accent, and schedule.
landing.how.step2.d: Sit with your teacher for a full session, on us. No card, no commitment. Continue only if it feels right.
landing.how.step3.d: Lock your weekly times and start the most consistent thing you'll do this year.
landing.stats.title: A growing circle of huffadh.
landing.stats.sub: Numbers don't memorise the Qur'an — people do. Here is the shape of our community, by His permission.
landing.courses.title: Five tracks. Choose your path.
landing.courses.sub: Every track is one-to-one. Combine tracks freely — most students study two.
landing.courses.item0.d: Memorise the Qur'an, page by page, with structured murajaah and weekly tests.
landing.courses.item1.d: Master the rules of recitation — makharij, sifaat, and the ten qira'aat.
landing.courses.item2.d: Read and understand the Qur'an in its own language. Grammar through ayah, not textbook.
landing.courses.item3.d: Complete recitation and ijazah with full sanad in Hafs 'an 'Asim.
landing.courses.item4.d: Gentle, playful tahfeez & Noorani Qa'idah for children 5–12 with parental updates.
landing.testimonials.title: Letters from our students.
landing.testimonials.item0.q: I had tried three apps and one local circle. None held. With Tahfeez I memorised seven juz in eighteen months while working full-time. The same teacher every Tuesday and Thursday — that is what changed everything.
landing.testimonials.item1.q: My daughter (8) asked to do the trial class. After it she asked when the next one was. A year later she finished Juz 'Amma. Her teacher knows her favourite surahs and her birthday.
landing.testimonials.item2.q: As a revert, I was ashamed to start. The intake was warm — they didn't quiz me, they asked how I was. I now read Surah Al-Mulk every night before sleep.
landing.testimonials.item3.q: I completed my ijazah in Hafs 'an 'Asim this Ramadan. I cannot describe the moment. Tahfeez made it possible across an ocean.
landing.cta.title:
The Qur'an is waiting.
One page is enough to start.
landing.cta.sub: Create your free account today. Your first session is on us. The intention itself is rewarded.
landing.footer.tagline: An online Tahfeez academy for the global ummah.
